chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Mismaʿ, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام:
“Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled regarding the piercing of the nose that it is one-third of the diyah of the nose.”
ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for piercing the nose in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling attributed to Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام concerning bodily injury compensation. It specifies that the diyah for piercing the nose is one-third of the full diyah assigned to the nose.
